## About
Mekatron started out in Berkeley working on racing and performance sports cars, along with English and European cars. Over time our Concord shop began to specialize in Japanese car repair, and later added Volkswagen and Audi as those cars earned their place.
Our focus is preventive maintenance, because keeping up with your car makes it more reliable, safer and easier on your wallet. We will never sell you a repair you don't need, or one before you need it. When we find something, we tell you what matters now and what can wait, based on how and where you drive.
Drivers have given us a 4.7 rating from 35 Google reviews. Stop by Concord Ave or give us a call to set up an appointment.

## Services
- Maintenance and factory services: Routine maintenance, including factory services, to keep your car running reliably.
- Smog diagnosis and repairs: Smog work, with diagnosis and repairs if your car needs them to pass.
- Check engine light diagnosis: We track down check engine lights, drivability problems, hard starts, overheating, electrical issues and strange noises.
- Brake repair and service: Brake service and brake repair for the import cars we work on.
- Air conditioning repair: Diagnosis and repair when your air conditioning stops keeping up.
- Wheel alignment: Alignments done on a computerized four wheel Hunter system.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: Japanese vehicles are our specialty, including Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Mazda, Subaru, Acura, Lexus, Infiniti, Mitsubishi, Isuzu, Hyundai, Kia, Scion and Suzuki. We also work on Audi, Volkswagen, BMW and Mercedes.

Q: Is there any work you don't do?
A: We repair or replace mechanical and electrical parts, but we don't do body work, sunroofs, windshield replacement or upholstery.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 am to 5:30 pm. We are closed Saturday and Sunday.
